thought.text: Several services show "Finished server process" (server exited after startup). Let me find why they're shutting down:

reasoning_content:
Multiple services show "Finished server process" and "Stopping reloader process" — meaning the uvicorn server process exited. This is concerning. "Finished server process" followed by "Stopping reloader process" usually means the server shut down — either it crashed after startup, or it exited due to an error.

Let's look for the reason. I'll search for error messages around the time of these exits.

action.command: grep -B8 "Finished server process" /tmp/process-compose.log | grep -viE "GET|migration|INFO.*Starting" | grep -E "ERROR|CRITICAL|Exception|Traceback|error|assert|raise|Exit|exit|shutdown" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -15
